summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of 252,594 ordinary shares from JP Morgan Securities plc under an existing buyback arrangement announced on 6 January 2026. Shares were bought on the London Stock Exchange at a volume-weighted average price of £11.8321 per share (range £11.72–£12.035). The company intends to cancel the repurchased shares, reducing issued share capital to ~2,519M shares. This open-market repurchase returns capital to shareholders and is conducted under shareholder authority from the 2025 AGM. Watch for continued execution pace and impact on EPS and share count.
